_doc: Base traps and electricity (ADR-0052, src/building/base_tech.gd). Distances in metres, real times in seconds, fuel in generator hours at full load, noise = Stimuli loudness (metres a normal listener just hears it). Damage to the Hollowed is scaled by the trap_damage world setting; fuel use by power_fuel_use.

traps._doc: Player-built traps. The Hollowed walk into them on their own paths: nothing lures them but the noise a trap makes when it goes off. wear: hit points the piece loses each time it works (repair it with a hammer like any piece); a spike pit below dull_below of its hit points does half damage.

spike_pit._doc: A pit lined with sharpened stakes. A Hollow that walks in takes damage at once, is held for stuck_seconds while it claws its way out, moves at slow x its speed while inside and keeps taking tick_damage every tick_seconds. A player who steps in takes player_damage (every player_cooldown at most).

deadfall._doc: A log hung over a trigger stick. The first body under it heavier than min_weight (traps.json hollowed classes) drops it: every Hollow under it takes damage (blunt, a heavy stagger), a player player_damage. Then it lies sprung until someone lifts it again (trap.rearm, hold [E]).

tripwire._doc: A bell on a cord strung low across a gap. A Hollow that walks through rings it (no more often than cooldown): the bell is heard by everything within noise, and you get a warning with the direction if you are within warn_radius.

power._doc: Electricity. A generator (provides power_source:<watts>) feeds every consumer (power_use:<watts>) wired to it, directly or through other wired pieces; a network's consumers are served in a fixed order until its running generators' watts run out. tick_minutes: game minutes between fuel and grid updates.

generator._doc: fuel_item: what fuels it, can_hours of full-load running per item, up to tank_hours. It burns idle_burn x the full-load rate with nothing drawing, rising to 1 at full load. As the fuel falls to low_fuel_fraction of a full tank the player hears low_text, and dry_text when it stops (StatusFeed warnings, only within warn_radius: about where its engine is heard; there is no base ownership to go by, so a generator dying across the map is found, not announced). While running it is heard (noise every noise_interval seconds) and its heat_per_minute (x the same load factor) builds attention on the heat map: a running generator draws the Hollowed to your base.
generator.low_text: The generator's running low on fuel.

wire._doc: Wiring between two pieces: item spools, metres_per_item metres each, a run of at most max_length. Cutting a wire gives its spools back; a wire on a destroyed piece is lost.

light._doc: An electric work light: a steady light while powered and switched on. stimulus_range: how far it lights you up for the Hollowed (Stimuli.register_light).

floodlight._doc: A floodlight on a motion sensor: dark until a Hollow moves within detect_range, then it lights for hold_seconds and warns you (at most every warn_cooldown) when you are within warn_radius.

turret._doc: A nail sentry on a motion sensor: while powered and loaded it fires at the nearest Hollow it can see within range, one ammo_item a shot every interval seconds, up to magazine loaded. Each shot is heard (noise).
